lead: A `Core\Ldap\Connection::changes` call against the Samba test directory takes about a second
body: , because each call starts a full sync. An attack in `tests/hostile/core/Ldap-Connection/changes/01-forged-cookies-and-bad-bases.nvs` that looped over `changes` a hundred times ran past a 90 s `timeout-ms` when another Samba program ran beside it. Loop over a sync call twenty times at most, and time a draft with `bun nv proofs --run --id '<feature>' --show` before you choose its timeout.
